_readme: Short booking links: leadfuse.co/book/<slug> opens the Free Discovery Call calendar with the source on it, so a call booked from a DM, a text or an email says where it came from. Same names as the apply links (apply/_src/sources.json): formsource = the value the App's source-tag workflow (01.17) already matches, utm_source / utm_medium = the shared naming, utm_campaign is always 'book'. Any utm_* added to the link (?utm_content=bf-blast) wins for that click. Add a row, run build.py, commit. Never rename a slug that has been sent to someone.
